## Wave 4 Summary

This wave harvests the S110 compact-object / black-hole cohort — three Tier-2/3 carry-forwards, each a substrate-IS observable on a relay-pattern configuration of the spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K)`. The compact object is NOT a metric solution embedded in a container; it IS a configuration of the fabric's eigenvalue spectrum, and every black-hole observable here is a spectral moment of `D_K` read FORWARD to an emergent-geometry quantity.

- **S111-CF-B5A-ISLAND** — the white-hole exit-slice **island microstate** count. The naive boundary-edge-mode count FAILed at S110 (`S110-CF-B5A-MICROSTATE` FAIL, `test_ratio=0.4737`: count ≠ A/4, undercount by ~factor 2). This gate tests the deeper QES/island construction `S_island = ext_X[ Area(∂I)/4 + S_bulk-EE(I) ]` against `A_horizon_FW/4` — does adding the bulk entanglement-entropy contribution of the island region close the factor-2 gap?
- **S111-CF-CO34A-12D-BUBBLE** — the full-**12D Gregory-Laflamme bubble maturation**. The reduced (4+8) τ̇²-gated GL growth was sub-critical (`S110-CF-CO34-BUBBLE-LRDT` INFO, `legA_N_efold=0.2324 < 1`). This gate lifts the GL acoustic-metric perturbation to the full 12D spectrum (the 90 Peter-Weyl sectors, block-diagonal), recomputes `N_efold = ∫ growth_rate dτ` over the Mach-13.75 transit window, and tests `N_efold ≥ 1` (mode-coupling the dropped sectors reaches the 1-e-fold permanent-structure threshold).
- **S111-CF-CO34B-LRDT** — the LRD **photosphere-temperature transport degree**, SHARPENED by the connes-mack workshop (corpus §23.0(5) parity selection rule). T is `d_A=+1` (odd) ⇒ forced onto the sign-locked `M_KK^1` scale leg; `deg(B)=+1` is DERIVED, not scanned. The gate pre-registers the κ-sign-consistency predicate — "∃ a substrate-natural transport with `deg(B)=d_A=+1` AND a `|κ|>1` morphism leg?" — expected **FALSE** (the deg=+1 residual is a +28.17-decade ASCENT requiring `|κ|>1`, sign-inconsistent with the `|κ|<1` substrate-natural transport). HELD/INFO via dimensionful-slot-collision ∧ sign-lock — NOT a fitted knob. LRD-T is a DIRECT JWST measurement with no relocation channel, so held-ness is falsifier-grade.

Carry-forward source: `session-110-w4-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (B5A magnitude FAIL, CO34-legA INFO, CO34-legB INFO), sharpened by `session-110-connes-mack-workshop.md` (CONVERGED 2026-06-21; CO34B specs).

```yaml
    Step 2: S_island := ext_X[ Area(partial I)/4 + S_bulk-EE(I) ]   [QES/island formula, Engelhardt-Wall / Penington-Almheiri-Maldacena-Stanford]
```

## §W4-2. S111-CF-CO34A-12D-BUBBLE

```yaml
# ---- Identity (7 fields) ----
gate_id: "S111-CF-CO34A-12D-BUBBLE"
schema_version: "R3"
gate_type: "compute"
trigger: "[SIGN]"                          # directional pre-registration: lifting to full 12D ADDS unstable channels, so N_efold can only GROW vs the reduced (4+8) 0.232
classification: "GEOMETRIC"                 # the GL instability is a property of the D_K^{≤L} TT-perturbation spectrum on the 12D acoustic metric; the bubble IS a spectral-triple instability, not a metric embedded in a container
agent_type: "schwarzschild-penrose-geometer"
hypothesis: "Lifting the reduced (4+8) τ̇²-gated Gregory-Laflamme growth (N_efold = 0.232 sub-critical) to the full 12D acoustic-metric perturbation — mode-coupling the dropped Peter-Weyl sectors — reaches the permanent-structure threshold N_efold = ∫ growth_rate dτ ≥ 1."

method:
  description: >
    The reduced (4+8) GL analysis (inv4_w2_gregory_laflamme_dynamical.npz) found the most-unstable
    TT mode at global_min_om2_eff = −44.26 M_KK² (τ = 0.19), giving a τ̇²-gated growth integral
    N_efold = 0.232 (sub-critical, S110-CF-CO34-BUBBLE-LRDT INFO legA_N_efold = 0.2324). This gate
    lifts the perturbation to the FULL 12D acoustic-metric TT sector: the GL operator is BLOCK-DIAGONAL
    by Peter-Weyl decomposition D_K = ⊕_{(p,q)} D_{(p,q)} (90 sectors at L12), so the 12D eigenproblem
    decomposes per-sector — no monolithic dense 12D matrix is built. For each Peter-Weyl sector (p,q)
    in the L12 cache, construct the GL TT-perturbation operator on the (4+8) acoustic metric with the
    sector's eigenvalue floor, compute ω²_eff(τ, p, q) across the transit window, and aggregate the
    growth over ALL sectors (the dropped sectors from the reduced analysis are now mode-coupled in via
    the full Peter-Weyl sum). Compute growth_rate(τ) = max_{(p,q), k} Re(√(−ω²_eff(τ,p,q,k))) over the
    unstable band, integrate N_efold = ∫_{transit} growth_rate(τ) dτ along the substrate τ(t) trajectory
    (Mach_max = 13.75, v_fold = 6.669, v_terminal = 26.545 set dτ/dt), test N_efold ≥ 1.
  producing_script: "computations/session-111/s111_co34a_12d_bubble.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "N_efold = integral_{transit} growth_rate(tau) d tau >= 1"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "1.0"
  direction: ">="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false                              # N_efold is a numerical integral of the GL growth rate over the per-sector 12D TT spectrum along the substrate trajectory; the 1-e-fold threshold is the standard permanent-structure criterion (analytic in motivation), the integral itself is numerical
  proof_ref: "null"

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false             # N_efold is a continuous integral; no rational mesh
  mesh_density: "continuous"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "300"                            # k_grid resolution for the GL dispersion (matches inv4_w2 k_grid shape (300,))
  L_max: "12"                              # full 12D Peter-Weyl sector set (s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz; 90 sectors)
  scan_range: "tau in [0.19, tau_exit]; k in [0, k_max]"   # transit window (fold at 0.19) and TT-mode wavenumber band (k_max from inv4_w2)
  step_size: "tau: 5-sample transit grid refined to 50; k: 300 grid"   # tau_samples (5) refined for the growth integral; k_grid (300) from inv4_w2
  tolerance: "1e-6"                        # ω²_eff eigenvalue convergence per sector
  scheme: "GL-dynamical-12D"               # continuity with S110-CF-CO34-BUBBLE-LRDT scheme tag
  convention: "SUBSTRATE-NATURAL-BINDING"  # the GL growth is read FORWARD from the substrate D_K^{≤L} TT spectrum (NOT a canonical-import binding); continuity with S110 legA convention
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"       # the L12 cache + deterministic GL operator construction carry no stochastic input
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg"                 # per-sector GL TT eigenproblem via torch.linalg.eigvalsh on ROCm (block-diagonal; largest block dim 9792 << VRAM); cross-checked vs numpy on a small test sector per computation-environment.md
  publication_precision: "4"               # N_efold published to 4 sig figs (consistent with legA_N_efold=0.2324 precision)

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Lifting from the reduced (4+8) to the FULL 12D Peter-Weyl spectrum ADDS unstable channels (more sectors with ω²_eff < 0 contribute to the growth integrand), so N_efold_12D >= N_efold_reduced = 0.232 — the integral GROWS, never shrinks (SIGN of the lift correction is POSITIVE / growth-increasing)."

    Step 1: N_efold = integral_{transit} growth_rate(tau) d tau          [definition; growth integral along substrate trajectory]
    Step 2: growth_rate(tau) = max over {(p,q) sectors, k modes} of Re(sqrt(-omega^2_eff(tau,p,q,k)))   [GL unstable-mode growth rate; Re(sqrt(-omega^2)) > 0 only where omega^2_eff < 0]
    Step 3: Reduced (4+8): growth_rate_red(tau) = Re(sqrt(-omega^2_eff)) over the SUBSET of sectors retained
            => N_efold_reduced = 0.232                                   [inv4_w2; min omega^2_eff = -44.26 M_KK^2]
    Step 4: Full 12D: the sector set is the SUPERSET (all 90 Peter-Weyl sectors); the max over a SUPERSET
            is >= the max over a SUBSET, pointwise in tau:
            growth_rate_12D(tau) = max over ALL 90 sectors >= max over retained subset = growth_rate_red(tau)
                                                                         [max over superset >= max over subset]
    Step 5: Integrate the pointwise inequality (integrand non-negative; growth_rate >= 0 by Step 2):
            N_efold_12D = integral growth_rate_12D(tau) d tau >= integral growth_rate_red(tau) d tau = N_efold_reduced = 0.232
                                                                         [monotonicity of the integral under pointwise >=]
    Step 6: SIGN of the lift correction: POSITIVE (N_efold_12D >= 0.232). The OPEN question is the MAGNITUDE —
            does the superset growth reach the 1-e-fold threshold?
    Conclusion: sign_verdict = PASS iff N_efold_12D >= 0.232 (the lift cannot decrease growth — a numerical
                check the script verifies). magnitude_verdict = PASS iff N_efold_12D >= 1 (matures to permanent
                structure). The DIRECTION (growth increases under the 12D lift) is structural; whether it
                CROSSES 1 is the substrate-physics content. NOTE: |min omega^2_eff| more negative OR more
                unstable sectors in-band => larger growth_rate => larger N_efold (the growth integral is
                monotone-increasing in the depth and count of unstable modes).

# (8) input_files
input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  gregory_laflamme_dynamical:

  spectrum_cache_L12:
```

## Wave 4 → Wave 5 Decision Point

Wave 5 (Floquet confirmatory + Stage-2 verify) does NOT consume any Wave-4 output as a numerical input. The one cross-reference is structural, not data-flow:

- **S111-CF-CO34B-LRDT (W4) ↔ S111-CF-KSIGN-PARITY-STAGE2 (W5)**: both touch the §VII.CF `κ-sign-lock ∧ Wodzicki-parity` joint theorem. W4 computes the HELD-number outcome on the LRD-T anchor (the falsifier-side landing); W5 runs the two-agent NON-AUTHOR Stage-2 PASS-AND on the theorem's clauses (the promotion-side verify). They are INDEPENDENT — neither gates the other. A W4 INFO (held, expected) and a W5 STAGE-3-PERMANENT (theorem promoted) are mutually consistent and jointly confirm the foreclosure (the theorem is proven AND its first falsifier-grade instance is landed). A W4 PASS (band lands via sign-consistent deg=+1, prior 0.05) would FLAG the W5 Stage-2 as a CONTRADICTION — but the two gates are dispatched independently; the orchestrator reconciles at session-end synthesis if the unlikely W4-PASS / W5-PERMANENT conflict arises.

No branching of Wave-4 gates feeds a Wave-5 dispatch decision; all three W4 gates run independently and in parallel with each other (no intra-wave dependency).

## Feasibility Envelope (12D eigenproblem + L12 spectral triple)

Per `.claude/rules/math-scripts.md §"Machinery-Feasibility Audit"` + §"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility Pre-Check":

- **B5A-ISLAND** (bulk-EE von-Neumann entropy) and **CO34A-12D-BUBBLE** (per-sector GL TT eigenproblem) both operate on the L12 cache, which is BLOCK-DIAGONAL by Peter-Weyl: `D_K = ⊕_{(p,q)} D_{(p,q)}`, 90 sectors. **Sparse storage is NOT necessary** — the largest single block at L12 is dim 9792 (sectors (15,0)/(0,15) would be at L15; at L12 the worst block is smaller), dense storage well under 17.1 GB VRAM with margin > 11×. The 12D GL eigenproblem decomposes per-sector; **no monolithic 12D dense matrix is built**. The operative cost is reading the pre-built L12 cache (`sector_evals` dict, 90 sectors, already on disk — NO recursive Casimir irrep construction needed at runtime, since the cache exists). GPU path: `torch.linalg.eigvalsh` on ROCm per sector, cross-checked vs `numpy.linalg` on one small test block.
- **Wall-time**: both gates load the L12 cache and iterate 90 sectors with per-sector dense eigvals (each ≤ 9792×9792, tens of ms on GPU) — estimated well under the 600s agent timeout (< 0.5× timeout). The growth integral (CO34A) and QES extremization (B5A) add O(300) grid evaluations of closed-form functionals, negligible.
- **CO34B-LRDT** is trivial scalar/OOM arithmetic (Sage RealField(200) for the eff-deg and |κ| precision); no GPU, no eigenproblem, sub-second.
- **VRAM cap check**: max dense block 9792² × 16 bytes (complex128) = 1.53 GB < 0.5 × 17.1 GB = 8.55 GB. PASS. No hard-halt.
